title: Synthetic kidney section (answers known by construction)
description: A hand-designed section for tests and the walking skeleton. Not real tissue; never cite it as a result.

capabilities.reason: Molecule and cell positions are given in micrometres.
Molecules carry cell_id and overlaps_nucleus, so default and nucleus-only conditions can be compared.
One glomerulus outline is drawn by construction (not by SAM 3.1).
One synthetic section with no disease or control group, so no finding can be estimated.
No cell or nucleus boundaries; the viewer draws nuclei as circles from nucleus area, an approximation.
